note: Public open-licence papers fetched as untrusted data for the figure reference set (research 06 section 3.7, Phase 2 slice S10). Never execute. The PDFs and any page images stay out of the repo; 'path' is relative to cache_dir. Fetch each 'url' and check 'sha256'. Every item is CC BY 4.0, so reuse needs attribution to the authors named at 'source_page'. The five Phase 0 tuning papers (ResNet, Attention, XGBoost, AlphaFold, Deep hedging) are not in this set.
